content.thinking: Oops, `l` isn't defined in the comprehension — I wrote `[[i,j,k,l] for i ... for j ...]` without binding k,l. Let me fix: approved = random 4-clauses; simpler: approved = a sample of discovered clauses. Let me build approved as a list of random clauses from range(32) of size ≤4.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, json, random, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from brute import brute_job

fields=[{'name':'f0','type':'count','domain':[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]}]
preds=[]
for k in range(4):
    for _ in range(8):
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'f0']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':k,'type':'count'}})
train=[[[0]],[[1]],[[2]],[[3]]]
queries=[{'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]},{'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':'1','fixed':[]}]
rng=random.Random(0)
approved=[]
seen=set()
while len(approved)<256:
    c=tuple(sorted(rng.sample(range(32),rng.randint(1,4))))
    if c in seen: continue
    seen.add(c); approved.append(list(c))
job={'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':approved,'queries':queries}
t=time.time(); res=compile_job(job); dt=time.time()-t
print('many-rule case: %.3fs rules=%d out=%dKiB active=%d' % (dt, len(res['rules']), len(json.dumps(res))//1024, len(res['active'])))
print('first rule:', res['rules'][0], 'last:', res['rules'][-1])
print('answers:', res['answers'])
t=time.time(); want=brute_job(job); print('brute %.2fs rules=%d' % (time.time()-t, len(want['rules'])))
print('match:', want==res)
PYEOF
